sources.conclusion: Regimen/population-specific nonpositive physical outcomes despite NAD augmentation; not universal NMN inefficacy or direct high-versus-low-dose comparison

synthesis.scientific_priority: Mechanistic plus mixed controlled human-function comparator
synthesis.comparison_to_niacin: More controlled design for the tested walking signal than inherited uncontrolled niacin functional observations; no comparative magnitude or MVA superiority established
synthesis.eligibility: Separate product-specific question; no new regulatory audit or approval conclusion
synthesis.unchanged_mechanistic_claims: North provides WT BUBR1 abundance evidence at high experimental exposure. Separately, Kang 2018 reports 0.5 mM NMN improving mitotic completion in NQO1-depleted MCF-7 cancer cells. That is functional division evidence, not niacin treatment, BUBR1-loss rescue, faithful daughter chromosome counts or muscle function. Genetic SIRT2 survival benefits remain separate. Product eligibility and actual-allele benefit at justified exposure remain unestablished.
